line: R22 alternative B (R22_ALTERNATIVES_CN.md section 2.B): online VCS posterior in place of NCR's per-epoch GMM clean probability, matched BCE posterior control
owner_rule: 2026-10-22: only the theory of Variational_Cauchy_Schwarz_divergence.pdf is fixed; every implementation choice is flexible and recorded here
status: PILOT_DEVELOPMENT; DEV only; no TEST read; no U clean-label read

decisions.decision: co_train.eval_train: after the official per-sample losses and GMMs, r22_posterior.replace_probabilities returns prob_A / prob_B; NCR then uses them exactly where it used the GMM clean probability: split_prob (p_threshold .5, labeled vs unlabeled) and the label rectification weight of the labeled set (targets = prob + (1 - prob) * prediction, soft margin). Co-teaching kept: network A's posterior divides the data for network B and vice versa. The GMMs are still fitted every epoch (fallback and comparison; same numerics and RNG use as NCR_A).

each network's own SGR similarity (sigmoid output, the score NCR ranks with), eval mode, no gradient. Observed pairs: diagonal of the official eval_train batch score matrix (eval_loss_and_diag makes the same calls as SGRAF.train(mode=eval_loss); per-sample losses bitwise unchanged). Q pairs: one extra eval pass over the 14,500 anchor Q pairs per network per epoch.

P = anchor pairs (trusted clean). Q = the same anchor captions re-paired with the observed image of another anchor pair of the same N2F role, never the caption's own image (N2F repair_within_role, cyclic shift of a random permutation), redrawn each epoch from numpy rng [seed, 22022, epoch, role]; identical for both networks and both arms. Roles from the V9 shared stage (pairs.observed_pairs.json / roles.json): FIT = critic_fit (4,350 pairs), SELECT = critic_select (2,175), REF = reference_moments + teacher_warmup (7,975). There is no teacher online; its anchors go to REF because the precision of rho-hat (three means) dominates the error of a 2-parameter critic.

f(s) = softplus(a_raw) s + b, T = tanh(f) (eq. 36); float64 full-batch Adam on FIT, the N2F scalar grid lr {1e-2, 3e-2, 1e-1} x init {(0,0), (1,0), (2,-1), (0,1)}, 400 steps each, refit from scratch every epoch (no warm start). VCS arm: 1 - J (eq. 40 with the anchor Q). BCE arm: balanced BCE on the natural logit 2f. Selection by the common J on SELECT for both arms (ties within 1e-12 keep the earlier grid point). Parameters are float64 (N2F's torch ScalarCritic kept float32 parameters; CPU check 5 compares the two).

rho-hat = (E_P T - E_U T) / (E_P T - E_Q T) on REF P / REF Q and all 130,500 U pairs (U_est = all U online; N2F's 20 % independent interval batch is not needed for a point estimate). Deployed iff the three means are finite, gap = E_P T - E_Q T >= .01 and 0 < rho_raw < 1; rho used = rho_raw (no projection). Otherwise that network keeps that epoch's GMM probability (fallback; counted and listed in R22_RESULT.json).

w = sigmoid(log1p(-rho) - log(rho) + 2 f(s)) for U pairs (= (1 - rho)(1 + T) / (1 + (1 - 2 rho) T)); anchors 1 (the anchor patch forces them to 1 / clean anyway, as in NCR_A). Same formula for both arms.

NCR_A of B1 unchanged: official NCR @60256ba + v9 anchor patch + N2P DEV-only patch, 5 warm-up + 40 co-training epochs, lr 2e-4 (x1, lr_update 30), batch 128, soft margin exponential, unlabeled term from epoch 20, V9 shared stage rho .4 / A .1 for seeds 901 / 902 / 903; every epoch candidate saved; full-DEV forward / package scorer / best full-DEV rSum (earliest exact tie) unchanged. Full runs refuse to start unless the NCR B0 gate (B0GATE_NCR_A_s917_r04) is B0_PASS with the same frozen config, base patch layers and forward / guard scripts.

NCR_A reused from B1 (V9N2P_f30k_r04_s90x_NCR_A, RTX PRO 6000 node59 / node61); not the same job; NCR runs with cudnn.benchmark, so even an NCR_A rerun is not bitwise reproducible. Disclosed beside every comparison.

full runs pinned to RTX6000PRO (exclude node51,node53,node60): NCR co-training has no resume; B1 NCR_A took 10.5-10.8 h training + 0.75 h DEV forward on RTX, i.e. about 19-21 h on L40S and 21-23 h on H100 at the measured SGR student ratios (x1.8 / x2.0), too close to the 24 h limit; and the NCR_A baseline ran on RTX (same GPU type).

schedule chk: both networks start from the same seed's B1 NCR_A post-warm-up candidate (warmup_04 of seed 901, the state the full run's first posterior epoch sees, up to cudnn nondeterminism), 2 co-training epochs, both arms; exercises the posterior twice, the unlabeled term (epoch 1 >= 2 // 2), candidate export, DEV forward, scoring and selection. Not a result.
